        CHECK(is_base=0 OR (base_value='1' AND currency_quantity=1))
    )

            CHECK((trade_id IS NOT NULL AND redemption_token IS NULL AND direction IN ('add','spend'))

objects.name: dnd_shop_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE dnd_shop_settings (
        chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, thread_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
        pricing_mode TEXT CHECK(pricing_mode IN ('b','m')),
        factor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', base_item_id INTEGER,
        currency_signature TEXT, currency_units TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(settings_version IN (1,2)),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        PRIMARY KEY(chat_id,thread_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(base_item_id,chat_id,thread_id) REFERENCES dnd_items(id,chat_id,thread_id),
        CHECK((pricing_mode IS NULL AND enabled=0)
           OR (pricing_mode IS NOT NULL AND base_item_id IS NOT NULL AND currency_signature IS NOT NULL
               AND length(currency_signature)=64
               AND ((pricing_mode='m' AND
                      ((settings_version=1 AND factor='1' AND enabled=0)
                       OR (settings_version=2 AND typeof(factor)='text'
                           AND length(factor) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
                           AND factor!='0' AND factor NOT GLOB '*[^0-9/]*')))
                 OR (pricing_mode='b' AND factor IN ('57/2000','57/200000'))))))

objects.name: dnd_shop_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE dnd_shop_settings (
        chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, thread_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
        pricing_mode TEXT CHECK(pricing_mode IN ('b','m')),
        factor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', base_item_id INTEGER,
        currency_signature TEXT, currency_units TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(settings_version IN (1,2)),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        PRIMARY KEY(chat_id,thread_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(base_item_id,chat_id,thread_id) REFERENCES dnd_items(id,chat_id,thread_id),
        CHECK((pricing_mode IS NULL AND enabled=0)
           OR (pricing_mode IS NOT NULL AND base_item_id IS NOT NULL AND currency_signature IS NOT NULL
               AND length(currency_signature)=64
               AND ((pricing_mode='m' AND
                      ((settings_version=1 AND factor='1' AND enabled=0)
                       OR (settings_version=2 AND typeof(factor)='text'
                           AND length(factor) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
                           AND factor!='0' AND factor NOT GLOB '*[^0-9/]*')))
                 OR (pricing_mode='b' AND factor IN ('57/2000','57/200000'))))))

        operation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('sending','sent','uncertain')),
        recipients_json TEXT NOT NULL, message_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY(session_id,step,claimed_at))

objects.name: story_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE story_sessions (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,thread_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      code TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registration' CHECK(status IN ('registration','active','finished','cancelled')),
      snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',node_id TEXT,step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      creator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

objects.name: story_steps
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE story_steps (
      session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES story_sessions(id),step INTEGER NOT NULL,node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      choice_id TEXT,next_node TEXT,result_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(session_id,step))

objects.name: story_votes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE story_votes (
      session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES story_sessions(id),step INTEGER NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      choice_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(session_id,step,user_id),
      FOREIGN KEY(session_id,user_id) REFERENCES story_participants(session_id,user_id))

            )

objects.name: dnd_currency_category_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dnd_currency_category_insert
            BEFORE INSERT ON dnd_currencies
            WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dnd_items WHERE id=NEW.item_id AND category='currency')
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Currency item category required'); END

objects.name: dnd_currency_category_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dnd_currency_category_update
            BEFORE UPDATE ON dnd_currencies
            WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dnd_items WHERE id=NEW.item_id AND category='currency')
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Currency item category required'); END

objects.name: dnd_currency_keep_category
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dnd_currency_keep_category BEFORE UPDATE OF category ON dnd_items
        WHEN NEW.category!='currency' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dnd_currencies WHERE item_id=NEW.id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Currency item category required'); END

objects.name: inventory_item_scope_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER inventory_item_scope_insert
                BEFORE INSERT ON inventory WHEN NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dnd_items WHERE id=NEW.item_id
                    AND chat_id=NEW.chat_id AND thread_id=NEW.thread_id)
                BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Item belongs to another D&D scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER mini_boss_timeline_actions AFTER INSERT ON mini_boss_actions
        WHEN (SELECT rules_version FROM mini_bosses WHERE id=NEW.boss_id)>=15
        BEGIN INSERT INTO mini_boss_timeline(boss_id,source,source_id) VALUES(NEW.boss_id,'actions',NEW.id); END
